## Featured Projects & Case Studies

### 1. Pocket — Penny Journal
- **Category**: Mobile Finance Application
- **Platform**: Android (React Native, Expo, SQLite)
- **Key Features**: 100% offline-first privacy, local SQLite transactions, Android home screen quick-logging widgets, zero tracking, sub-3-second expense entry.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/donclaine123/pocket

### 2. Ecart — Modern E-Commerce Platform
- **Category**: Full-Stack E-Commerce System
- **Platform**: Web (React 19, Next.js, Laravel 11 REST API, Supabase PostgreSQL, Stripe)
- **Key Features**: Product catalogs, real-time inventory management, secure Stripe checkout flow, transactional notifications, granular role-based authentication.
- **Live Demo**: https://myecart.vercel.app

### 3. QR Code Attendance & Monitoring System
- **Category**: Real-Time Enterprise Operations Platform
- **Platform**: Web (Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL, Vanilla JS)
- **Key Features**: Instant QR badge scanning for college faculty, live attendance dashboards via WebSockets, automated time-in/time-out logging, audit logs.
- **Live Demo**: https://employeattendance.vercel.app

### 4. EazyAttend Student Attendance System
- **Category**: Educational Technology Platform
- **Platform**: Web (PHP, MySQL, Bootstrap, JavaScript)
- **Key Features**: Session-based student attendance verification, encrypted authentication, section management, exportable attendance reports.
- **Live Demo**: https://eazyattend.netlify.app/
